1.0.1.en: Added inlet and outlet as sensor data

1.0.2.en: Added real power measure as sensor data

1.0.4.en: Fixed login issue. Fixed missing insights on outlet temperature.

1.1.0.en: Ask for username and password, when adding device. Removed the old app settings page. Added support for multiple devices.

1.2.0.en: Added new values. Current/ampere, temperature for surrounding and inverter frequency.

1.6.0.en: Updated translations on labels. Now released on the original app id, so we can go out of test phase (and make a public release)

1.7.0.en: Updated text on app store. Fixes crashes when updating from very old version to newest version

1.8.0.en: Added temperature for exhaust and evaporator. Added fan speed. Better error handling.

1.8.1.en: Removed the 'off' mode. Now we only have one place for switching device on and off. By the switch.

1.8.2.en: Fixed wrongly shown frequency value (it was the exhaust temperature). Added setting for experimental features. Those features are controlling fan speed and frequency of compressor.

1.8.3.en: Handle error when device is not available.

1.8.4.en: Fix bug when device is not available.

1.9.0.en: Added defrost detection — the app now shows when the heat pump is in defrost mode and you can use it in flows. Minor update of app and device icons. Energy/power consumption is changed to being cumulative, so it will work as a power meter. Value is calculated so not completely precise.

1.10.0.en: Fixed current/ampere reading. Fixed thermostat mode flow card not working. Fixed outlet temperature not being added correctly on upgrade. Fixed app not cleaning up the poll timer on device removal. Fixed crashes when the device API returns unexpected data. Added energy dashboard support.
